text: The current Calendar row uses calendarDialogRowTemplate as its DOM ID, calendarDialogRowTemplate.inc.xhtml as its included template and browser_calendarDialogRow.js as its test. These roles retain a shared row stem while using different local file/identifier conventions. Existing shared lessons cover the dashed custom tag/module and PascalCase class. Preserve the exact template and test spellings when adding sibling rows; a blanket filename-case conversion would lose this local mapping. This is scoped naming guidance, not a whole-repository filename rule. Static source and test-code inspection only. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and review discussion remains pending.
